style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Set of 3 Rattan Light Up Mushrooms
style.toneOfVoice: Add a whimsical touch to your festive display with this charming set of three indoor outdoor light up mushrooms. Crafted from natural-look rattan woven around a metal frame each mushroom gives off a soft, warm glow, perfect for brightening up garden paths, porches, and indoor spaces. Designed for ease and practicality, the mushrooms features a built-in timer (8 hours on, 16 hours off), so you can enjoy coming home to a beautifully lit entrance way with no need to switch on or off all season long. The three mushrooms connect together on one mains plug, keeping setup simple and tidy. For added stability outdoors, they come with cable ties and ground pegs. For stress-free storage, the mushrooms can be disassembled and stored neatly inside the largest toadstool head year after year. WHIMSICAL FESTIVE CHARM: Brighten up your garden, porch, or indoor space with this magical Charles Bentley light up Mushroom Set – a unique and eye-catching addition to any Christmas display. SINGLE PLUG CONNECTION: All three mushrooms link together and run from just one mains plug – making setup simple and reducing trailing cables around your display. TIMER FUNCTION INCLUDED: Built-in 8hr on / 16hr off timer ensures your lights come on and go off automatically each day – for hassle-free festive decorating. SECURE & WEATHER READY: Supplied with cable ties and ground pegs to keep the mushrooms securely in place outdoors – ideal for garden paths, lawns or driveways. STACKABLE FOR STORAGE: Designed with convenience in mind – each mushroom can be disassembled and neatly stored inside the largest mushroom head for compact storage. DIMENSIONS: Large: W45cmxH45cm, Medium: W30cmxH35cm, Small: W18cmxH25cm, Cable Length: 5m ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Plug in power source, Plug type: Type C / F: 220 - 240 Volt, IP44 Rated Plug, Adapter type: C/F, Micro LED lights Size: ONE.
